import os, sys, glob
r = os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT', '')
if not (r and os.path.isdir(os.path.join(r, 'baton_mcp'))):
    hits = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.expanduser('~/.claude/plugins/cache/ryfter/baton/*/baton_mcp')), key=os.path.getmtime, reverse=True)
    r = os.path.dirname(hits[0]) if hits else ''
launch = os.path.join(r, 'baton_mcp', '_launch.py') if r else ''
if launch and os.path.isfile(launch):
    os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, launch])
sys.stderr.write('baton-mcp: could not locate baton_mcp/_launch.py (plugin root: %r)\n' % r)
sys.exit(1)
